neighbours.label: the word for slowness across languages: English ' slowly' and Chinese 慢 (很慢, 太慢), as opposed to words for speed or manner in the same sentences
fire: The tired horse climbed slowly up the muddy track.
Add the milk slowly while you keep stirring the eggs.
The boat drifted slowly past the old harbor wall.
Her fever came down slowly over the next three days.
The crowd moved slowly toward the gates after the match.
这条路上的车开得很慢，我们迟到了。
他说话太慢，大家都等得不耐烦。
电脑运行很慢，我只好重新启动。
quiet: The tired horse climbed quickly up the muddy track.
Add the milk carefully while you keep stirring the eggs.
The boat drifted silently past the old harbor wall.
Her fever came down suddenly over the next three days.
The crowd moved calmly toward the gates after the match.
这条路上的车开得很快，我们到早了。
他说话太多，大家都等得不耐烦。
电脑运行正常，我只好继续工作。

short: the word for slow: ' slowly', 慢
notes: Card: ' slowly' x23, 慢 x8, 慢性 of the top 32. Probes: ' slowly' 0.41-0.49, 很慢 0.88, 缓慢 0.29; quickly 0.06, gently 0.04, 很快 0.12-0.13. Adjective ' slow' reached 0.25 and sentence-initial 'Slowly' 0.16, so the adverb in mid-sentence is the core.
